subject: Code
title: Check if a Number is Prime
description: Given a positive integer N, determine whether it is a prime number. A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.
explanation: 7 is only divisible by 1 and 7 itself, so it is a prime number. We only need to check divisibility up to the square root of N for efficiency.

subject: Code
title: Fibonacci Number
description: Given an integer N, find the Nth Fibonacci number. The Fibonacci sequence starts with 0 and 1, and each subsequent number is the sum of the two preceding ones: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …
explanation: The Fibonacci sequence is: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(2)=1, F(3)=2, F(4)=3, F(5)=5, F(6)=8. We use an iterative approach with O(N) time and O(1) space.

subject: Code
title: Greatest Common Divisor (GCD)
description: Given two positive integers A and B, find their Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) using the Euclidean algorithm. The GCD is the largest number that divides both A and B without a remainder.
explanation: Using the Euclidean algorithm: GCD(36,24) → GCD(24,12) → GCD(12,0) = 12. The algorithm repeatedly replaces the larger number with the remainder of dividing the two numbers until the remainder is 0.

subject: Code
title: Reverse a String
description: Given a string S, reverse it and return the reversed string. For example, "hello" becomes "olleh".
explanation: We use a two-pointer technique: swap characters from both ends moving towards the center. This runs in O(N) time and O(1) extra space (in-place for mutable representations).

subject: Code
title: Check Palindrome
description: Given a string S, check whether it is a palindrome. A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Ignore case during comparison.
explanation: Converting to lowercase: "racecar". Comparing from both ends: r==r, a==a, c==c, e (middle). All characters match, so it is a palindrome.

subject: Code
title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Given an array of strings, find the longest common prefix among all the strings. If there is no common prefix, return an empty string.
explanation: Comparing character by character: index 0 → all have "f", index 1 → all have "l", index 2 → "o" vs "o" vs "i" — mismatch. The longest common prefix is "fl".

subject: Code
title: Find Maximum Element
description: Given an array of integers, find and return the maximum element in the array.
explanation: We iterate through the array, keeping track of the largest value seen so far. Starting with the first element (3), we update the max when we find a larger value: 3 → 7 → 9. The answer is 9.

subject: Code
title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target sum, find two numbers in the array that add up to the target. Return their indices. Assume exactly one solution exists.
explanation: We use a hash map to store each number and its index. For each element, we check if (target - current) exists in the map. At index 0: value 2, complement 7 not in map. At index 1: value 7, complement 2 is in map at index 0. Return [0, 1].

subject: Code
title: Sort an Array (Merge Sort)
description: Implement the Merge Sort algorithm to sort an array of integers in ascending order. Merge Sort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm that splits the array in half, recursively sorts each half, and merges the sorted halves.
explanation: Merge Sort divides the array into halves until single elements remain, then merges them back in order. Split: [38,27,43,3] and [9,82,10]. Continue splitting until individual elements, then merge pairs in sorted order. Time complexity: O(N log N).
